---
title: Create Automation
description: >-
  Create automated customer workflows by naming your trigger rules, selecting
  specific system events, and configuring targeted communication actions to run
  on auto-pilot.
---
<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="1374" height="759" style="width: 1374px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

## Step

1. Navigate to Automation > Add Automation.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="290" height="192" style="width: 290px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

2. Enter a name and select the type of automation to categorize your workflow.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="559" height="223" style="width: 559px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

3. Choose a specific customer group.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="577" height="227" style="width: 577px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

4. Choose the trigger type and select the date when the automation should execute.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="590" height="220" style="width: 590px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />

5. Select the specific coupon and submit.

<Image src="data:image/png;base64," width="646" height="245" style="width: 646px; height: auto; cursor: pointer;" />
